status.corrupted: The settings file was corrupted; backup or defaults were loaded and the original kept.
status.reset_backup: Defaults restored; previous settings backed up: {path}

localization.description: System follows the OS locale; the interface refreshes immediately.

reset.description: Removes registered settings and restores factory values; unknown keys and agent authorizations are kept, and the previous settings are backed up first.

appearance.font_family_description: Comma-separated primary and fallback families; applies to new terminals.
appearance.font_size_description: Logical pixels, 4-96; applies to new terminals.
appearance.ligatures_description: Follow theme defers to the theme typography.
appearance.theme_description: Dark built-in themes only; the terminal palette resolves immediately.
appearance.custom_theme_description: Fork a draft from the built-in catalog or library; save and apply are separate actions.
appearance.opacity_description: Drag to preview; release to save.
appearance.scroll_speed_description: Drag to preview; release to save; 0.25x-4x.
appearance.scrollback_description: Applies to new terminals; open sessions keep their history.
appearance.tab_close_description: Middle-click still closes tabs when hidden.

agents.description: Install slTerminal lifecycle hooks for detected AI CLIs. Installation and removal run through the hook installer; the editor below only touches your own handlers.
agents.helper_missing: Hook helper missing from this installation
agents.initialize: Start this agent once, then refresh
agents.restart: Restart the CLI after changing hook installation.
agents.editor_description: Only your own handlers are editable. Groups installed by slTerminal are read-only and survive saves unchanged.

profiles.startup_directory_description: Empty inherits the current directory; applies to new terminals.
profiles.refresh_environment_description: New processes read the latest system environment.
profiles.notification_duration_description: Default keeps each notification's own duration.

interaction.paste_confirm_description: Confirms newlines, elevated commands and control characters.

advanced.proxy_description: New local terminals inherit the system proxy environment.

placeholder.startup_directory: Leave empty to inherit the current directory

theme_editor.template_description: Switching a template replaces only the draft; the source and applied runtime stay untouched.
theme_editor.name: Name
theme_editor.name_description: The first save always creates a new theme and never overwrites built-in or existing library themes.
theme_editor.foreground_description: Recommendations keep the original first; cool/warm candidates meet WCAG AA.
